item.title: Emotion concepts and their function in a large language model
item.description:
📝 5 and found emotion-related representations that shape its behavior. But our key finding is that these representations are functional, in that they influence the model’s behavior in ways that matter. This is not to say that the model has or experiences emotions in the way that a human does.
